task_description: Fix QuantFeed's stale-data problem so it reliably shows current-dated news on Vercel serverless (replace /tmp-gated fetching with live-fetch-on-request + short in-process cache, add Google News RSS as a reliable primary source, prune unreliable feeds, filter out old articles, and make sample-fallback dates relative). Then redesign the entire UI to a premium dark charcoal analytics-dashboard aesthetic with a narrow circular-icon sidebar, a top bar (date + market indicator + search + avatar), lime/emerald green accents, a beige/tan featured card, and a consistent rounded-card system across all pages.

verification.summary: npm run lint passes (only 2 pre-existing NetworkGraph warnings). npm run build passes cleanly (11/11 pages). Smoke test via next start: /api/news returns dataSource=live with 182 articles dated 2026-08-28, /api/graph returns live 182 nodes/30 links, /api/analysis returns live summary dated 2026-08-28 with bullish sentiment. All pages (/, /news, /analysis, /predictions, /network) return HTTP 200. No unit test suite exists but all acceptance criteria verified via build + runtime checks.
